title: 第172章 冷战
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

亭栖云邸，三楼客卧。

门外是淅淅沥沥的雨声，潮湿的空气被遮挡在了窗台以外。

巨大的落地窗上湿漉一片。

男人手中拿着湿毛巾，擦拭着指骨。

每根指骨连同指缝都被擦拭，修长的指骨白皙完美，手背上有微微凸起的青筋。

宋瓷身上穿着的是一件睡裙，除了出现一些压痕褶皱，全身没有半分狼狈。

一杯水递到了宋瓷手边。

宋瓷接过男人手中的手背，润了润嘴巴。

此时的宋瓷坐在飘窗上。

因为飘窗太凉的原因，男人在她的身下垫了几张纸。

——是刚刚他递给她的合同。

她说，她不需要。

电话已经被挂断了，此时她的手机被扔在了沙发上，手机屏幕亮了几次，不断震动着。

是方喻之发来的消息。

并未看向手机，祝砚铮看着坐在飘窗前，稍稍有些卸力的她，缓缓开口：“好好考虑，改变主意了林鉴随时重拟合同。”

他似乎近乎偏执地想要将那些股份和房产给她。

宋瓷动了动眼珠，面上却只是低下头去，一言不发。

“这几天我都有空，”祝砚铮语气平静，“订婚宴场地一起去挑。”

“早些休息。”

说完，祝砚铮转身离开。

外面的雷雨声震耳欲聋。

闪电划破寂寥的夜空，冷色的光线照映在宋瓷身上。

看着祝砚铮离开的背影，宋瓷微微眯眼。

她发现，她其实不够了解祝砚铮。

——他的“怒气”，似乎有些过了头。

微微抿唇，宋瓷眼中闪过一抹深意。

祝砚铮在跟宋瓷冷战。

说冷战似乎又不太准确，因为除了不跟之前那样频繁跟宋瓷聊天通话之外，两人一起上下班，一起用餐吃饭，甚至一起回家，又跟平时没什么不同。

但就连林鉴也察觉到了两人之间气氛的不对。

驾驶位上，林鉴透过后视镜看了一眼车子后排。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Tingqiyun Mansion, guest bedroom on the third floor.

There was the sound of rain pattering outside the door, and the humid air was blocked from the window sill.

The huge floor-to-ceiling windows were wet.

The man held a wet towel in his hand and wiped his phalanges.

Each finger bone and the seams between the fingers were wiped. The slender finger bones were white and perfect, and there were slightly raised veins on the back of the hand.

Song Ci was wearing a nightgown. Except for some creases and wrinkles, she didn't look at all embarrassed.

A glass of water was handed to Song Ci.

Song Ci took the back of the man's hand and moistened her mouth.

At this time, Song Ci was sitting on the bay window.

Because the bay window was too cold, the man put a few pieces of paper under her body.

——It was the contract he just handed her.

She said she didn't need it.

The call had been hung up, and her cell phone was thrown on the sofa. The screen lit up several times and kept vibrating.

It was a message from Fang Yuzhi.

Without looking at the phone, Zhu Yanzheng looked at her sitting in front of the bay window, a little relieved, and slowly said: "Think it over carefully. Lin Jian can re-draw the contract at any time if he changes his mind."

He seemed almost obsessed with giving those shares and property to her.

Song Ci moved her eyes, but she just lowered her head and said nothing.

"I'm free these days," Zhu Yanzheng said calmly, "Let's pick the venue for the engagement banquet together."

"Go to bed early."

After saying that, Zhu Yanzheng turned and left.

The thunderstorm outside was deafening.

Lightning pierced the lonely night sky, and the cold light shone on Song Ci.

Looking at Zhu Yanzheng's leaving figure, Song Ci narrowed her eyes slightly.

She discovered that she actually didn't understand Zhu Yanzheng well enough.

——His "anger" seems to be a bit excessive.

Pursing her lips slightly, Song Ci's eyes flashed with deep meaning.

Zhu Yanzheng was having a cold war with Song Ci.

It seems inaccurate to say a cold war, because apart from not chatting and calling Song Ci as frequently as before, the two of them commuted to and from get off work together, ate together, and even went home together, which was no different from usual times.

But even Lin Jian noticed something was wrong with the atmosphere between the two.

In the driver's seat, Lin Jian glanced at the back of the car through the rearview mirror.
